newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch prime minister Kok to visit Japan.
newsitem.headline: Dutch prime minister Kok to visit Japan.

text.p: Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok and Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo will pay an official visit to Japan from November 4 to 7, a Dutch government spokeswoman said on Thursday.

Kok and Van Mierlo will have talks with Japan's Emperor Akihito and prime minister Ryutaro Hashimoto. They will also meet industry leaders. The trip will include visits to Nagasaki, Kobe and Osaka, the spokeswoman said.
On November 7 Kok will continue alone to the Philipinnes, where he will address a seminar on environmental issues in Manila on November 8.
